entries.title: II Timothy 3:1
segments: Know this also, that in [the] last days grievous times will be [on us].

entries.title: II Timothy 3:2
segments: For men will be self-lovers, money-lovers, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:3
segments: without natural affection, unyielding, false accusers, without self-control, savage, despisers of good,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:4
segments: traitors, reckless, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:5
segments: having a form of godliness, but denying the power of it; even turn away from these.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:6
segments: For of these are those who creep into houses and lead captive silly women loaded with sins, led away with different kinds of lusts,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:7
segments: ever learning and never able to come to the full knowledge of [the] truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:8
segments: But as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so these also resist the truth, men of corrupt mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:9
segments: But they shall proceed no further. For their foolishness shall be plain to all, as theirs also became.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:10
segments: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, love, patience,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:11
segments: persecutions, afflictions, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra. What persecutions I endured! But the Lord delivered me out of all.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:12
segments: Yea, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:13
segments: But evil men and seducers will go forward to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:14
segments: But continue in the things that you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned [them],

entries.title: II Timothy 3:15
segments: and that from a babe you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:16
segments: All Scripture [is] God-breathed, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:17
segments: that the man of God may be perfected, thoroughly furnished to every good work.
